_comment: Strict JSDoc type checking over the code that ships: the shared domain, the server, and
the gate tools. No build output is produced — this only checks.
test/ is deliberately NOT included. Tests construct malformed parameters and interrogate
the Result union on purpose, so a strict check there produces a steady stream of complaints
about the very things a test is for. Test code is verified by RUNNING it, which is a
stronger check for a test than a type check: `npm test` exercises every assertion, while a
reference/ is excluded: it is the audited baseline, read but never built.
public/ is excluded from this config because it needs the DOM lib and runs in a browser.
It is covered by the boundary test, which loads modules the way the browser does.
